data.Name: The Storm Caller
data.Description: Find and defeat the entity summoning the devastating storms
data.Template_Text: Lightning splits the sky as you push deeper into the cursed territory. [NPC1] can barely keep up, shouting over the thunder: "There! [Enemy1] — the Storm Caller!" The figure stands atop [Location1], arms raised, channeling raw fury from the clouds. End this now!
data.Chain_Config: {"on_success":{"mode":"auto_activate","quest_card_id":"quest_chain_storm_aftermath","inherit_placeholders":["NPC1"],"message":"The storms fade at last, but the damage is already done. The people need help.","set_transition":"transition_aftermath"},"on_failure":{"mode":"none"}}
data.2nd_state_Template_Text: With a final crack of thunder, [Enemy1] falls from [Location1]. The clouds part and sunlight breaks through for the first time in days. [NPC1] collapses with relief. But the land lies ravaged — villages need supplies.
